luayang: 1
tipo: banco

materia: Inglés
columnas: [orixinal, pista, solucion, estrutura]

| orixinal | pista | solucion | estrutura |
|---|---|---|---|
| It is said that the actor is very kind. | to | The actor is said to be very kind. | pasiva impersoal |
| The referee panel postponed the match because of the rain. | by | The match was postponed by the referee panel because of the rain. | pasiva |
| He is too young to drive. | isn't | He isn't old enough to drive. | too/enough |
| He started playing tennis five years ago. | has | He has been playing tennis for five years. | present perfect |
| "Will you help me carry this?", she asked. | whether | She asked whether I would help her carry that. | estilo indirecto |
| He didn't go out because he was tired. | been | If he hadn't been tired, he would have gone out. | condicional 3 |
